tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Audit the email-authentication DNS records of a domain. Returns a 0–100 score and A–F grade (MX 10, SPF 25, DMARC 30, DKIM 25, BIMI 10, plus up to 5 bonus points for MTA-STS and TLS-RPT, capped at 100), each check's status, published record, findings and recommended fixes, and a link to the full rep

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_domain · Private data: check_domain · Public sink: check_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_domain · Private data: check_domain · Public sink: check_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
